articles.title: European leaders gather in Dublin to discuss Ukraine's security, and their own
articles.description: Leaders from more than 40 European countries gathered in Dublin on Thursday, November 12, for a summit focused on the continent’s fragile security, amid a new US-backed effort to revive talks on ending the Russia-Ukraine war. The meeting of the European Political Community brought together heads of state and government from European countries and the UK, as well as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte.

articles.title: Ukraine live: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrive in Russia to meet Putin
articles.description: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Russia for a meeting with President Vladimir Putin after two days of talks in Abu Dhabi, Russian news agencies said Thursday. When they leave Moscow, the US negotiators plan to fly to Ireland where they will meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, due to attend a meeting of European leaders there. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

articles.title: Throwing cow dung: Diwali celebrations take an unusual turn in southern India
articles.description: The third day of Diwali was marked in a memorable way on Wednesday in Gummatapura, a hamlet located in India's Tamil Nadu state. Local men and boys threw cow dung at each other to celebrate the festival of Gorehabba which honours Lord Beereshwara, a God worshipped by locals. Believed to be around 300 years old, the festival attracts tourists from across India and further afield.

articles.title: Paraguayans get some savings back after banking collapse disrupted economy
articles.description: Paraguay's Central Bank said Wednesday, November 11, it had partially returned savings to all eligible Ueno Bank depositors locked out of their accounts when it collapsed last week. The digital bank's takeover on November 3 triggered massive protests across Paraguay and led to the impeachment and arrest of ex-president Santiago Pena, who is linked to Ueno.

articles.title: Déserts médicaux : quel bilan pour le plan de lutte lancé en 2025 ?
articles.description: Plus de 6 millions de Français sans médecin traitant, 87% du territoire classé "désert médical"... Face à cette situation, François Bayrou, alors Premier ministre, lançait en avril 2025 un appel à la solidarité des généralistes : venir en renfort quelques jours par mois dans les zones les moins bien dotées. Où en est-on un an et demi plus tard ? "Envoyé spécial" fait le point sur un dispositif controversé.

articles.title: Le Canada envisage d’abolir la « loi sur les Indiens », vestige de la colonisation

articles.title: "Déconstruire un rapport de confrontation à l'autre" : le travail d'une unité judiciaire à priorité éducative pour aider des mineures qui risquent la prison

articles.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins historic Senate race in Mississippi
articles.description: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi after a final count on Wednesday, becoming the state's first Black US senator since Reconstruction. articles.title: Le département de la Haute-Corse placé en vigilance orange aux crues, après une forte montée des eaux du fleuve Tavignano

articles.title: En Espagne, le Parlement vote un texte pour protéger le droit au logement, avec notamment des mesures contre les fonds « vautour »
articles.description: Alors que la droite promet d’abroger ces mesures si elle revient au pouvoir, le texte adopté jeudi suspend les expulsions de personnes vulnérables jusqu’en 2030 et cible les fonds dits « vautour ».

articles.title: Présidentielle : TF1 et LCI organisent un débat entre cinq candidats sur la grande précarité
